dangerous_cpts.main_problem: The CPT strongly favors HIGH LVEDVOLUME under HYPOVOLEMIA=Hypovolemia and LVFAILURE=FALSE, which is physiologically inconsistent and is repeatedly implicated across both CVP and PCWP suspicious paths. This is a localized upstream error with direct downstream impact on multiple measurements.

suspicious_parameters.justification: Under hypovolemia without LV failure, HIGH filling volume should not dominate. Lowering this probability is the clearest semantically supported correction and could repair both CVP and PCWP downstream behavior.

dangerous_cpts.main_problem: The hypovolemia-to-stroke-volume effect appears too weak in the column for HYPOVOLEMIA=Hypovolemia and LVFAILURE=FALSE, where LOW stroke volume receives only 0.5. This can blunt the hemodynamic consequence of hypovolemia along the BP path.

suspicious_parameters.justification: Hypovolemia should more strongly favor reduced stroke volume when LV failure is absent. Increasing this entry is a focused way to strengthen the intended causal effect without broadly altering unrelated parts of the network.

cpt_danger_report.overall_summary: The refinement search space should stay narrow and focus primarily on LVEDVOLUME, with STROKEVOLUME also included as a secondary but well-supported hemodynamic contributor. Other reported parameters are better explained as downstream reflections of these upstream mappings or have insufficient failure-specific support.

suspicious_parameters.justification: Low LVEDVOLUME should not favor high CVP, so even this small probability mass appears misallocated. Because it is concentrated entirely in failures and absent in successes, reducing it is a well-supported, low-collateral refinement.

cpt_danger_report.overall_summary: Only the CVP CPT is sufficiently supported for inclusion in the refinement search space. Other activated parameters are either on uncertain or consistent paths, or show substantial success-side activation that weakens the case that their own CPT values are causing the failures.

suspicious_parameters.justification: Even though the probability is already very small, this parameter is the only one specifically localized by a suspicious path and it is activated exclusively in failures.
